The '''Imperial scan cruiser''' was a model of [[Imperial Gozanti-class cruiser|Imperial ''Gozanti''-class cruiser]]<ref name="Secrets" /> deployed by the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[4 BBY]], one scan cruiser visited the agricultural world [[Mina-Rau]] to assist in performing the [[planet]]ary audit.<ref name="One Year Later" />

==Behind the scenes==
An Imperial scan cruiser appeared in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the [[Disney+]] live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' which was released on [[April 22]], [[2025]].<ref name="One Year Later" /> It was identified as a "Imperial scan cruiser" in the article "Secrets from the Set of ''Andor'' Season 2: Week 1 Trivia" posted to [[StarWars.com]]. In the same article it was revealed that digital model for the cruiser was a modified version of the [[Gozanti-class cruiser]] that [[Industrial Light & Magic]] made for the [[The Mandalorian Season Two|second season]] of [[Star Wars: The Mandalorian|The Mandalorian]].<ref name="Secrets" />
